abstract: BACKGROUND: The aim of this study was to investigate the impact of the histological findings on the treatment of malignant ovarian tumors in pregnant women. METHODS: This is a retrospective study of 41 patients diagnosed and treated for ovarian malignancy during pregnancy between 1985 and 2010. RESULTS: The median age of the study group was 30 years old, ranging from 20 to 41. Thirty-eight (92 %) patients were diagnosed with stage I, and one (2 %) with each of stages II, III, and IV. Twenty-five (61 %) patients had borderline malignancy, 8 (20 %) were diagnosed with epithelial ovarian cancer, 7 (17 %) with germ cell tumor, and one with sex cord stromal tumor. All patients received primary surgery; 7 (17 %) patients had cystectomy, 32 (78 %) had unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, and 3 (7 %) underwent hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Thirty-one (76 %) patients delivered live newborns; 21 had borderline tumor (84 %), 2 had ovarian cancers (25 %), and 8 had non-epithelial tumor (100 %). Six cases were terminated in order to perform the standard treatment for ovarian malignancy and 2 cases aborted spontaneously. CONCLUSION: In pregnant women, ovarian cancer is exceptionally less frequent compared with non-pregnant women, i.e. age-matched, statistically-corrected controls based on the Japanese annual report [8/33 (24 %) vs. control (60 %); ovarian cancer/(ovarian cancer + borderline tumor), P = 0.001]. The pregnant women with ovarian cancer chose to prioritize treatment of ovarian cancer at the sacrifice of their babies while those with borderline tumor or non-epithelial tumor were able to successfully deliver live newborns.
abstract_ja: 背景：本研究の目的は、妊婦の悪性卵巣腫瘍の治療に対する組織学的所見の影響を検討することであった。方法：1985年から2010年の間に妊娠中に卵巣悪性腫瘍と診断され治療を受けた41例を対象とした後方視的研究である。結果：対象者の年齢中央値は30歳(範囲20〜41歳)であった。38例(92%)が病期I、残りは病期II、III、IVが各1例であった。25例(61%)は境界悪性腫瘍、8例(20%)は上皮性卵巣癌、7例(17%)は胚細胞腫瘍、1例は性索間質性腫瘍と診断された。全例が初回手術を受け、7例(17%)は嚢腫摘出術、32例(78%)は片側卵管卵巣摘出術、3例(7%)は両側卵管卵巣摘出を伴う子宮全摘術を受けた。31例(76%)が生児を出産し、そのうち21例(84%)は境界悪性腫瘍、2例(25%)は卵巣癌、8例(100%)は非上皮性腫瘍であった。6例は卵巣悪性腫瘍の標準治療を行うため妊娠を中断し、2例は自然流産となった。結論：妊婦においては、卵巣癌は非妊婦と比べて例外的に少ない。日本の年次報告に基づく年齢をマッチさせ統計学的に補正した対照群との比較では、卵巣癌/(卵巣癌+境界悪性腫瘍)の割合は8/33(24%)対対照60%であった(P=0.001)。卵巣癌を有する妊婦は、児の犠牲を伴っても卵巣癌の治療を優先する選択をした一方、境界悪性腫瘍または非上皮性腫瘍の妊婦は生児の出産に成功した。
